task.name: Hartmann 3D
task.description: Local Hartmann 3D task with the primary-source relationship and evaluation changes specified in its protocol notes. Related cost-aware BO profile: https://arxiv.org/html/2404.16906v1 Section 4 and Table 1. The named analytic functions/dimensions are retained, but the cost model is changed: local c(x)=1+mean(normalized x), whereas paper Equation 5 uses exp(-||normalized x-normalized x*||_2). The local loop uses five initial points, a fixed Matérn GP, a random candidate pool and five seeded shifted instances of each function (one loop seed per instance; see the integrity note); source uses 2*d initial points and multistart acquisition optimization. Local budget 30 and simple-regret scores do not reproduce the source benchmark.
task.contract: acquisition(mu, sigma, f_best, cost) -> one score per candidate point; the loop stops when accumulated cost exceeds the budget (EvolCAF-style; cost(x) = 1 + mean normalized coordinate, a documented stand-in for the paper's cost functions). Each named function is evaluated on five fixed seeded shifted instances f(x - s_k) whose global minimiser lies at a seeded point of the inner 80% of the box (same box, minimum value, budget and cost model). Score: mean simple regret over the instances (and over the functions)
